```python
import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None:
            return
        try:
            v = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return
        if not np.isfinite(v):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": round(v, 1) if metric in ("share", "rank") else round(v, 2),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    num = ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
           "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]
    for c in num:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    # ---- Totals ----
    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw and lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (tw - lw) / lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly and ly != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (tw - ly) / ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), "sum(Orders_TW)")

    # ---- Top entities by revenue ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False)
    for _, r in top.head(5).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this product")
    if len(top):
        t1 = top.iloc[0]
        add(t1["Entity"], "share", "TW",
            t1["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan,
            "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(t1["Entity"], "rank", "TW", t1["Rank"], "Rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")
    add("TOTAL", "share", "TW",
        top.head(5)["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan,
        "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- Biggest WoW movers (absolute GBP) ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["wow_abs"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    up = d.sort_values("wow_abs", ascending=False).head(3)
    for _, r in up.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["wow_abs"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    dn = d.sort_values("wow_abs", ascending=True).head(3)
    for _, r in dn.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["wow_abs"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- Biggest WoW percent movers (material base only) ----
    p = df.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct", "Revenue_TW"])
    p = p[p["Revenue_TW"] >= p["Revenue_TW"].median()]
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- Biggest YoY movers (absolute GBP) ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y["yoy_abs"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("yoy_abs", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["yoy_abs"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("yoy_abs", ascending=True).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["yoy_abs"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")

    # ---- Top units / orders ----
    u = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(u):
        add(u.iloc[0]["Entity"], "units", "TW", u.iloc[0]["Units_TW"], "max(Units_TW)")
    o = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(o):
        add(o.iloc[0]["Entity"], "orders", "TW", o.iloc[0]["Orders_TW"], "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
